paragraphs.text: Syr Ellivere of the Wild Court is a human knight from Eldraine .

Ellivere, now Syr Ellivere, was born to a noble family in Ardenvale when it still stood tall and Kenrith ruled as High King. She was peculiar, she spoke no words nor cried until her tenth birthday when, during the ceremony, she was to release a caged dove. As she opened the cage, the dove clambered onto her outstretched hand where it rested calmly. Only when she spoke the word " fly " to her new friend did it flutter away. In the years thereafter, her parents bought her pets from all over the Realms to keep her company, which Ellivere would free soon after they arrived. Whatever trouble this brought, her mothers were simply overjoyed to see their daughter finally express herself. She took the path of knighthood as soon as she was able, giving her a chance to venture beyond the walls of her castle. As a squire , Ellivere was a handful, but her loyalty and strength proved her worth time and time again.

After the New Phyrexian Invasion destroyed her home at Ardenvale, Ellivere wandered the Realm , helping who she could. When Will Kenrith claimed the title of High King, he dubbed her Syr Ellivere as a reward for her devotion to the people of Eldraine , making her the youngest to ever become a knight. Her first task? Venture into the Wilds in search of a cure for the Wicked Slumber that assails the Realm. In the Wilds, Ellivere felt the same sense of ease she had among her animals at home. All manner of peaceful critters of the Wilds came out to greet her, from ouphes and bunnicorns to faeries and bumble sheep . Now she tromps through the tangled woods with her new friends. After all, what is a knight without a squire or two at their side?
